app.name: Rich Investor

adjusted.roaNote: Raw ROA is distorted by settlement balances typical of payment processors; adjusted ROA is used for the buy-worthy check.

trajectory.title: Why this growth category
trajectory.intro: The bars are reported earnings per share; the line is the growth rate fitted through them, which is what the category is read from.
trajectory.curve: Earnings per share per year, with the fitted growth rate drawn through them.
trajectory.noFit: Too few positive years to fit a rate; the endpoint figure is used instead.

pegBasis.both: passed on both realised and expected growth

trend.tooSoon: Only one evaluation so far. The nightly scan builds this up from here.

review.title: My qualitative review
review.intro: The app has done everything it can measure. This part it cannot answer for you.
review.checklistReminder: {met} of {total} quantitative conditions met. The review below is the final step before a buy decision.

assessment.label: Is the problem temporary or structural?
assessment.help: The book's own next question: a slowdown over one or a few quarters, with the growth story intact, is not the same as structurally deteriorating results.

review.marksQuestion: Looking back on this moment five years from now, would you have wanted to buy more shares or fewer?

history.intro: Every save is kept, so you can see where you changed your mind. Saves made before this log existed are not in it.

macro.title: Market context
macro.subtitle: The book's temperature gauge: not a timing tool, an indication of how much effort finding a buy-worthy stock will take.

buffett.name: Buffett indicator
buffett.help: Total US market capitalisation divided by GDP. Buffett called 70–80% cheap; above 150% the market is expensive, and it passed 200% in 2025. It says nothing about when to act — only how hard the hunting will be.

yieldSpread.name: Yield curve (10y − 2y)
yieldSpread.help: The gap between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields. Negative means an inverted curve. The book's point is about direction rather than level: since the 1960s the S&P 500 averaged 14.5%/year through falling-rate periods against 0.8% through rising ones.

concentration.name: Index concentration
concentration.help: One-year return of the cap-weighted S&P 500 minus the equal-weighted one. A wide positive gap means the index is being carried by its largest members. The book notes only 28% of constituents beat the index in 2024, a record low.

sp500Pe.name: S&P 500 P/E
sp500Pe.help: Trailing price-to-earnings for the index as a whole, as a baseline to read a single company's multiple against. Taken from SPY, which tracks the index and reports one where the index itself does not.

thesis.title: AI thesis summary
thesis.intro: A short bull and bear read on the fundamentals, generated on request from the figures on this page. Not advice, and not a substitute for your own review below.
thesis.staleNotice: Written against an earlier signal; refresh to bring it up to date.
